name: claude-atlas
description: Source-cited Obsidian knowledge bases for Claude Code, and projects that live in your work: an inbox to ingest from, one reviewed operation per change, git history in every knowledge base, and tasks with phases in an atlas/ folder beside your code. Skills for ingesting, querying, linting, describing projects, tasks, canvases, and Bases. Pairs with the claude-atlas binary, which serves the tools.
